scripts.reason: Most tooling behavioral tests use node:test and subprocesses; no validated mutation activation across them.

infra.reason: Compose, service configuration and SQL/shell provisioning have no native TypeScript mutation target. Shell activation needs separate validation before opt-in.

packages/test-logger.reason: createTestLogger wraps Pino with a name and LOG_LEVEL fallback to silent. Establish that contract before activation validation.

packages/test-utils.reason: Container fixture implementation requires separate multi-family isolation and activation validation; ordinary E2E coverage is insufficient.

packages/testcontainers.reason: Container/reaper suites include child processes whose mutation activation is unvalidated.

packages/url-ipv4-resolver.reason: The resolver suite uses live DNS for example.com; deterministic resolver inputs must be validated before repeated mutation execution.

packages/vitest-config.reason: Shared defaults and defineBaseConfig compose dependent Vitest suites; no standalone mutation score. The existing mutationContext dependency traversal hashes tracked dependency inputs, changes checkpoint compatibility and watches this package to widen dependent source selection. Preserve workspace dependency declarations for consumers; external undeclared inputs require externalInputs.

experiments/cosine_color_accuracy.reason: Interactive color-ranking experiment with Sharp image loading, vector and color calculations. src/index.ts reads a hard-coded personal Downloads directory and stdin; only start-dev is declared, with no maintained assertion suite. Controlled image inputs and an agreed calculation/ranking contract are needed before activation validation.
